description:
1. User reported excessive empty left margin/space before message content on mobile in the chat UI, wanting that space reclaimed.
2. I traced the mobile chat render path: QuickChatView → ChatView → Chat → ChatMessageList, finding no padding in the outer layers.
3. Root cause identified in `src/components/chat/ChatMessageList.vue`: wrappers used `max-w-[860px] mx-auto` (centering) plus `px-3`/`@lg/panel:px-4`, adding up to ~82px of left inset.
4. Proposed a mobile-scoped fix: `w-full px-2` for both the messages column and composer wrappers, leaving the desktop centered 860px layout untouched.
5. No other files needed changes; desktop/split-view behavior is preserved and mobile readability/edge spacing is maintained.

Looking at the current `CodeViewer.vue`, the main mobile space problem is the **actions toolbar** — up to 11 buttons crammed into a horizontally-scrolling row. The **quick icons** in the title and the **stats details** (timestamp, size) also add clutter. My plan: - Move all non-critical actions into a single DaisyUI **`dropdown menu`** (`fa-ellipsis-vertical`) that appears only on mobile (`md:hidden`). - Keep only the two most-used actions (**Save**, **Copy**) always visible; every other button gets `hidden md:inline-flex` so desktop stays byte-for-byte identical. - Hide the title quick-icons (`edit`, `task`, `refresh`) on mobile and re-expose them inside the overflow menu. - Hide `modified time` / `size` on mobile and surface them as a `menu-title` header inside the menu. ```vue src/components/CodeViewer.vue ``` ## Change summary | Area | Before | After | |------|--------|-------| | **Actions toolbar** | Up to 11 buttons in a scrolling row on every viewport | Desktop: unchanged. ` submenu inside the mobile menu | | **Stats (time/size)** | Always in the header | `hidden md:inline` — surfaced as a `menu-title` inside the menu | | **Menu visibility** | — | New `showMoreMenu` computed avoids an empty kebab button | ## Why this helps (Designer notes) - **Space**: 11 icon buttons → 3 (Save, Copy, kebab). The header no longer wraps into 2–3 rows. - **Function-first**: `Save` (destructive-free, most important) and `Copy` (frequent) stay one tap away; rarely-used destructive actions (Rollback, Discard) are safely nested. - **DaisyUI idioms**: `dropdown`, `dropdown-content`, `menu`, `menu-title`, `details/summary` submenu — all native components, no custom CSS. - **Desktop untouched**: every desktop button keeps its exact markup (only a `hidden md:` utility was added), so behaviour and layout are byte-for-byte identical. ## Anti-patterns avoided - ❌ Never hiding `Save` behind a menu (primary action must never be buried). - ❌ Nested `dropdown` inside an `overflow-x-auto` container (clipping bug) — the menu sits as a sibling of the scroll container. - ❌ Using JS breakpoint detection where a pure `md:` utility is enough. ## Accessibility checklist - ✅ The kebab button has `aria-label="More actions"`. - ✅ Menu reuses the same semantic `
